newsitem.title: USA: Fortune sells two units to U.S. Office. [CORRECTED 18:48 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Fortune sells two units to U.S. Office. [CORRECTED 18:48 GMT]

text.p: Fortune Brands Inc has sold its Sax Arts & Crafts Inc and Don Gresswell Ltd units to U.S. Office Products Co for an undisclosed amount.
Fortune Brands will post a capital gain from the sale of the businesses, which generated a combined $47 million in revenues annually, it said in a statement on Tuesday.

"The gain will be netted against previously announced total companywide restructuring charges of about $200 million, a company spokesman said. The gain is not expected to be material, the spokesman said." (corrects to clarify that the gain is smaller than restructuring charges)
Sax distributes arts and craft supplies, primarily to primary and secondary schools in the United States. Don Gresswell is a distributor of library supplies in Britain.
Fortune Brands, which was previously known as American Brands before the spin-off of its Gallaher Group Plc tobacco unit, makes Moen faucets, Master locks, golf equipment and distilled spirits.
